operations.description: One 60 Hz tick with n independent CCD spheres striking either one wall once or two walls successively, at synchronized TOIs, plus b distant non-contacting static boxes. Every sphere must complete 1 or 2 impacts and retain its remaining-time trajectory; the event scheduler preserves unchanged future contacts and locally invalidates only affected exclusions. Distant statics are pruned through the existing query tree and distant moving sweeps through a transient swept-bound tree (#469); cached events wait in a versioned chronological heap.

metrics.name: pair-tests
metrics.notes: O(k·n) tests in these fixtures with n mutually distant projectiles and k=1 or 2 wall impacts each (#469, was O(k·n²)): fixed bodies are pruned through the existing query tree and moving targets through a transient tree of their conservative remaining swept bounds, refreshed from the impact time when an impact changes a trajectory; an impact re-searches only sources overlapping a changed body's old or new sweep. The test enforces <= 4n for k=1, <= 6n for k=2, independent of b. Building the unpruned moving-body list visits all bodies once per CCD step; tree traversal is accounted separately.

metrics.name: tree-nodes
metrics.notes: Conservative fixed-body tree candidate visits, the transient moving-sweep tree's candidate and invalidation queries (#469, O(log n) per search for distant sources, was O(n²) linear candidate checks) plus the ordinary step broad phase; no worse than linearly in unrelated statics.

Shared exact fixture with ccd_dense_scaling; setup excluded. This is not a measured production crowd distribution or a portable frame-time budget.

storage.description: 1 Ordered, 2 Indexed; categorical control, not a growth dimension

metrics.name: pair-tests
metrics.notes: Conservative O(L n³) bound for this all-awake sphere-only coupled fixture, L=8 fixed, not an inferred fit or a claim of quadratic work. Closing events consume at least one unfrozen endpoint budget: C <= Ln. Each nonclosing event excludes its unordered pair until an endpoint trajectory epoch changes; no sleeping bodies wake. Thus F <= n(n-1)/2 + 2Ln(n-1). Initial searches cost <=n² candidates. A closing event can fully re-search n sources with <=n candidates each; a false event fully re-searches only its two endpoints (<=2n). Other marked sources check <=3 imminent targets or <=2 changed targets, so false-event work <=5n and closing-event work <=n² (n>=8). Including ordinary broadphase, pair tests <=2n²+Ln³+5nF. Exact sphere sweeps are a subset of candidate pair tests. This counts geometry operations only: BVH visits, sorting, BTreeMap exclusions, heap entries and CPU cost are not bounded by this metric. Observed pair/sweep counts at n=8/16/32/64/128: 389/198, 3300/1360, 16077/6133, 73583/25861, 291277/104472, identical across storage modes; phase growth is retained. Once a search has a hit at time t, a sphere/box candidate whose padded swept bounds over [0,t] miss the source's skips its exact sweep (#485; was 310/2734/13818/65540/264976 sweeps): admitted events and state bits are unchanged and the class bound is not tightened.

metrics.name: sweep-queries
metrics.notes: Conservative O(L n³) bound for this all-awake sphere-only coupled fixture, L=8 fixed, not an inferred fit or a claim of quadratic work. Closing events consume at least one unfrozen endpoint budget: C <= Ln. Each nonclosing event excludes its unordered pair until an endpoint trajectory epoch changes; no sleeping bodies wake. Thus F <= n(n-1)/2 + 2Ln(n-1). Initial searches cost <=n² candidates. A closing event can fully re-search n sources with <=n candidates each; a false event fully re-searches only its two endpoints (<=2n). Other marked sources check <=3 imminent targets or <=2 changed targets, so false-event work <=5n and closing-event work <=n² (n>=8). Including ordinary broadphase, pair tests <=2n²+Ln³+5nF. Exact sphere sweeps are a subset of candidate pair tests. This counts geometry operations only: BVH visits, sorting, BTreeMap exclusions, heap entries and CPU cost are not bounded by this metric. Observed pair/sweep counts at n=8/16/32/64/128: 389/198, 3300/1360, 16077/6133, 73583/25861, 291277/104472, identical across storage modes; phase growth is retained. Once a search has a hit at time t, a sphere/box candidate whose padded swept bounds over [0,t] miss the source's skips its exact sweep (#485; was 310/2734/13818/65540/264976 sweeps): admitted events and state bits are unchanged and the class bound is not tightened.

metrics.name: impacts
metrics.notes: Admitted closing impacts <=8n, asserted per sample by the test; measured 12/62/136/268/533. Fixed ceiling 8*128 covers declared n<=128 points only. Coupled trajectories change the output with size (12→62 exceeds doubling), so no fitted linear growth claim.

metrics.name: budget-fallbacks
metrics.notes: Each body freezes at most once; <=n, measured 0/11/32/64/128. Zero at n=8 prevents a meaningful fitted growth assertion. Fixed ceiling covers the declared n<=128 scale points; the test separately asserts <=n.

metrics.name: full-scan-bodies
metrics.notes: Existing current-tree guarantee remains zero.
